in_sanskrit.name: चपल
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who speaks with a stick or rod, a master, a guru.

in_hindi.name: Chapal
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Younger brother
in_hindi.long_meaning: Chapal एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'chapa', meaning 'younger brother'. In Hindu mythology, Chapal is an epithet for the god Vishnu, symbolizing his protective role as the younger brother figure to the universe.
